notes: Game pictures are now kept in the media folder under the game's own name - BLOODSTRIKE.png instead of game-p7k2.png - so a shop opening that folder can tell which picture belongs to which tile. Better still, a picture dropped into the media folder named after a game becomes that game's artwork on its own, with nothing typed and no dialog opened: forty pictures copied in once rather than forty trips through the panel. A tile that already has a picture is left alone, and renaming a game still keeps the picture it was given.
